entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The god and progenitor of the Phyrexian race, originally a human medical genius of the Thran Empire, and the main antagonist of multiple sagas.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: An abandoned artificial plane that Yawgmoth seized and made his world.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Yawgmoth's home plane, which he wished to remake under his rule.

entities.name: Thran Empire
entities.description: The ancient empire in which Yawgmoth was born and whose capital was Halcyon.

entities.name: Halcyon
entities.description: The Thran capital, destroyed when the Null Sphere was sabotaged.

entities.name: Rebbec
entities.description: Glacian's wife and chief architect, who brought Yawgmoth back, loved him, and later closed the portal to Phyrexia.

entities.name: Glacian
entities.description: The chief artificer of the Thran Empire, stabbed with a powerstone and stricken with phthisis.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: An Untouchable who stabbed Glacian and became a compleated Phyrexian of Yawgmoth's Inner Circle.

entities.name: Dyfed
entities.description: A planeswalker who agreed to find Yawgmoth a plane for his paradise and was killed by Rebbec's mercy.

entities.name: Xod
entities.description: A healer who gave Yawgmoth the idea of a metal-based serum against phthisis.

entities.name: Untouchables
entities.description: Exiled Thran who lived in the Caves of the Damned and caught phthisis.

entities.name: Halcyte Guard
entities.description: The guard of Halcyon, which Yawgmoth took complete control of.

entities.name: Phthisis
entities.description: The disease Glacian caught, caused by powerstone radiation.

entities.name: Null Sphere
entities.description: A device that filtered the stonechargers' deadly gases before they reached Halcyon, sabotaged by the artificers who controlled it.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The race created by Yawgmoth by altering Thran who fled to Phyrexia.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: An archeologist who, with his brother Mishra, disturbed the sealed portal; he activated the Sylex and became a planeswalker who attacked Phyrexia.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother, replaced by a Phyrexian and later turned into a machine.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: An artifact so powerful that Urza's activation of it devastated Dominaria.

entities.name: Shard of the Twelve Worlds
entities.description: A side effect of the Sylex blast that locked twelve worlds off from the multiverse, keeping the Phyrexians out.

entities.name: Brotherhood of Gix
entities.description: Gix's minions who infiltrated both sides of the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: A Newt intended as a Sleeper Agent whom Urza met.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: A being who healed Urza and whose realm the Phyrexians later invaded and corrupted.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A planeswalker who cast the World Spell to escape the Shard, opening Dominaria to Yawgmoth again.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: An artificial plane Yawgmoth created to fill with troops and merge with Dominaria.

entities.name: K'rrik
entities.description: A Sleeper Agent who destroyed Urza's academy on Tolaria and was defeated by Urza with Multani's help.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Urza's silver golem, sent back in time to prevent the academy's destruction.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: The island where Urza's academy trained mages to fight Phyrexia.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: A nature spirit who helped Urza defeat K'rrik.

entities.name: Croag
entities.description: An Inner Circle member who oversaw Rath and devastated Keld.

entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: The true heir to Urza's Legacy who completed it aboard the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The skyship that was the main part of the Legacy.

entities.name: Urza's Legacy
entities.description: A collection of artifacts made for the single purpose of destroying Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: A Yawgmoth minion who commanded Phyrexian armies and oversaw Rath's overlay onto Dominaria.

entities.name: Tsabo Tavoc
entities.description: A Yawgmoth minion whose plagues and shock troops devastated Dominarian nations.

entities.name: Gaea
entities.description: The Dominarian worldsoul that Yawgmoth believed Rebbec had become.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Yawgmoth's full-scale invasion of Dominaria launched in 4205 AR.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: A godlike being who summoned color gods and later heard a voice claiming to be Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Arabeja
entities.description: In Mercadian myth, the wife of Iachem-oath.

entities.name: Null Moon
entities.description: A moon launched by Thran artificers that gathered white mana for millennia.

events.summary: During his exile Yawgmoth commits atrocities across Dominaria, including spreading plagues among dwarves, elves and minotaurs.
events.quote: he committed many atrocities

events.summary: The elves pay ransom for their kidnapped priest and cure, and Yawgmoth delivers only sweetened water and twelve dead healers.
events.quote: he delivered to them only sweetened water and 12 dead healers.

events.summary: Yawgmoth is recalled to Halcyon when Rebbec seeks a cure for Glacian's disease.
events.quote: Glacian's wife Rebbec used her influence as chief architect to bring Yawgmoth back

events.summary: Yawgmoth discovers phthisis is caused by powerstone radiation and Gix begins rallying the Untouchables to revolt.
events.quote: Gix , started rallying his fellow Untouchables to rebel and take vengeance upon the Thran.

events.summary: Yawgmoth quells Gix's rebellion with free serum and is made a member of the Halcyon council.
events.quote: Yawgmoth was made a member of the council of Halcyon

events.summary: It is discovered that Yawgmoth is diluting the serum, and he uses the resulting unrest to gain control of the Halcyte Guard.
events.quote: Yawgmoth used this development to attain more funding and complete control over the Halcyte Guard.

events.summary: Yawgmoth talks the planeswalker Dyfed into finding a plane for his paradise.
events.quote: Dyfed agreed to find a plane where Yawgmoth could build his paradise.

events.summary: Yawgmoth uses an artifact to control all powerstone technology and forces Gix into obedience.
events.quote: he managed to stop the invasion and force Gix into complete obedience.

events.summary: Delegates declare war on Yawgmoth's supporters; Yawgmoth and Rebbec cast the tie-breaking votes, and Yawgmoth overthrows the council.
events.quote: He immediately overthrew the council and imprisoned its elders, as well as the delegates.

events.summary: Dyfed opens a portal to Phyrexia, where Yawgmoth binds himself to the plane's core and becomes a god.
events.quote: Yawgmoth bound himself to the plane within its core, becoming a god while staying there.

events.summary: Yawgmoth stabs Dyfed with a powerstone dagger and Rebbec mercy-kills her.
events.quote: Rebbec removed the powerstone however, mercy-killing Dyfed.

events.summary: The artificers sabotage the Null Sphere, destroying Halcyon.
events.quote: Halcyon was destroyed, all its inhabitants fleeing to Phyrexia or being eaten away.

events.summary: Rebbec closes the portal between Phyrexia and Dominaria, locking Yawgmoth out.
events.quote: locking Yawgmoth and his followers out for all eternity.

events.summary: Yawgmoth transforms the Thran refugees into the first true Phyrexians, who conquer planes.
events.quote: transforming them into the first true Phyrexians.

events.summary: Urza and Mishra disturb the powerstone seal; Yawgmoth sends Gix through to manipulate their war.
events.quote: Yawgmoth sent Gix , now a fully compleated Phyrexian and a member of his Inner Circle , through the portal as a scout.

events.summary: Urza activates the Sylex, devastating Dominaria; the resulting Shard keeps the Phyrexians out and Yawgmoth has Gix imprisoned in the 7th Sphere.
events.quote: A furious Yawgmoth had Gix thrown into the 7th Sphere of Phyrexia, where he would be tortured for all eternity.

events.summary: Reborn a planeswalker, Urza attacks Phyrexia and blasts a hole to the 4th Sphere; Yawgmoth invades his mind and Urza flees.
events.quote: Yawgmoth himself invaded his mind and made him go even more insane.

events.summary: Freyalise casts the World Spell, reopening Dominaria to Yawgmoth; Gix is released but Urza destroys the Sleeper Agents and kills Gix.
events.quote: He first destroyed all Sleeper Agents and then killed Gix.

events.summary: Yawgmoth creates the artificial plane of Rath to prepare a full invasion of Dominaria.
events.quote: He started to amass an army and created the artificial plane of Rath

events.summary: K'rrik destroys Urza's academy on Tolaria despite Karn's time travel; Urza later defeats K'rrik with Multani's help.
events.quote: K'rrik succeeded in destroying the place, but Urza sent the silver golem Karn back in time to prevent this.

events.summary: Croag discovers Urza's Bloodline project and Yawgmoth raids Dominaria to kill the results, but Gerrard slips through.
events.quote: Urza had started the Bloodline project

events.summary: Yawgmoth launches his full-scale invasion of Dominaria in 4205 AR.
events.quote: Yawgmoth finally launched his full-scale invasion of Dominaria in 4205 AR.

events.summary: Yawgmoth becomes convinced his true foe is Rebbec's spirit as the worldsoul Gaea.
events.quote: Yawgmoth became convinced that his ultimate foe was not Urza

events.summary: Yawgmoth returns to Dominaria as a world-spanning black death cloud that kills and resurrects defenders.
events.quote: He did so in the form of a black, world-spanning death cloud that killed Dominaria's defenders and resurrected them to fight for Phyrexia.

events.summary: Urza and Gerrard puncture the Null Moon, Gerrard completes the Legacy, and a sentient light kills Yawgmoth.
events.quote: dissolving and killing him at last.

events.summary: A century later Karona hears a disembodied voice claiming to be Yawgmoth in shattered Phyrexia but flees.
events.quote: There she met a disembodied voice claiming to be Yawgmoth
